title: [review] dao_manager.py:801: Thread-unsafe snapshot me
description: route_state_snapshot() reads multiple shared state variables (_freshness, _candidate_map, _descriptors, _candidate_timing, _parent_map, routing_table) without acquiring _lock. Since _apply_dao_at_unlocked assigns these variables sequentially (lines 717-724), a concurrent DAO processing thread could update some but not all state between reads, causing either inconsistent snapshot data or KeyError if a target exists in _freshness but not yet in _candidate_map or _candidate_timing (line 815 accesses _candidate_timing[(target, candidate.parent)] for each candidate). The same issue affects routing_table_snapshot() at line 862.
